hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.js|*.jsx|*.ts|*.tsx|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.css|*.md|*.yml|*.yaml) ROOT=$(git -C "$(dirname "$FILE")" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && [ -d "$ROOT/platform" ] && (cd "$ROOT/platform" && npx --no-install prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$FILE" >/dev/null 2>&1) ;; esac; exit 0
